invariants.title: Nobody is in it
invariants.rule: No figure anywhere - the wall alone.
invariants.why: The audience should wonder who is on which side.

invariants.title: The wall is whole
invariants.rule: The pile reaches higher than a man across the whole aisle.
invariants.why: A gap in it would undo 070's promise that the aisle ends blocked.

invariants.title: It is LTX
invariants.rule: The take in the film is LTX-2.5's.
invariants.why: The board's clatter comes with LTX's sound.

flair.title: The board
flair.note: slides once, late in the shot

title: the wall
beat: The aisle, blocked by the wall of broken crates. Nothing moves but settling dust and one board sliding down.

build.script: LTX-2.5 (70) from a Qwen-Image-2.1 start frame (qwen21_s11) · take 11
